title: 尾款未到账不放单 (TD-AT08): 670.00 of 672.00 before shipment → COMMERCIAL_RELEASE_BLOCKED → resolve 2.00 → granted
deviations: The order is formed on the terms from the start (the S3 foundation's payment.30-70 revised to revision 2 before the trading profile, costing context and quote bind it) instead of C1's amendment of an active order to them: the core design's BRC-001 terms (D-20).
The 288.00 and 672.00 receipts are applied to the order's payment stages (target order_stage), as C1 did; the sales statement after the shipment moves both applications to the receivable (D-4).
